Acknolegments:

The Star Wars theme of Setites ("Sithites") using Revelation of the Sire on
Caitiff ("I am your father."), and then Corrupting vamps to the Dark Side was
mine. I've had it for a long time.

However, Legbiter's deck "The Were-theres of Young Sorrow" at
http://legbiter.tripod.com/decks/weretheres.htm showed me a *fun* way to
build a Star Wars mass corruption deck. Not just a cheesy one-joke wonder,
as mechanical and predictable as a 1-cap Computer Hacking deck. So thank him
for the Change of Target + Venenation and the Revelation of Desire tech.

Observations from my "beta-test":

I have tested this deck, as it now stands, twice. I lost. But with
exiting, cliffhanger-style end games, which could have gone either way.
Not crushing defeats.

Mask of a Thousand Faces was a poor substitute for Change of Target, which
I simply don't own enough of. And I need more Revelations of Desire.

I did not get a chance to play a single Ecstasy. In both games, I faced
bounced, responsible zero-stealth bleeds for five or six. No bleeds for one.
Gah!

The Revelation of the Sire + Caitiffs tech depends way way too much on a
good crypt shuffle. Fully Setite crypt and Embraces would be the way to go.
Unfortunately, it would dilute the main joke.

Wakes would be a good addition. And more combat and/or stealth.

This deck suffers from a typical Setite problem: crushing offense, but
feeble defense.

Ezekiel looks *exactly* like Anakin Skywaker. And ten points for the
fashion sense of Count Ormonde.

In the movies, the Sith were combat monsters. My guys are anything but.
I can't see a way to fix this. :-)


